# Download the Fingertips AMR local indicators

Retrieves every indicator in the UKHSA Fingertips "AMR local indicators"
profile (profile 101) with fingertipsR: antibiotic prescribing,
antimicrobial resistance, bacteraemia / *C. difficile* case counts,
susceptibility testing, stewardship and infection prevention and
control. Data are fetched for *all* available area types (GP practice,
Sub-ICB, ICB, trust, CCG, STP, region, England) and are kept
un-aggregated, with numerator (`count`) and `denominator` columns, so
discrete (non-rolling) series can be analysed directly. `count` and
`denominator` are `NA` where UKHSA disclosure control suppresses small
numbers.

## Usage

``` r
download_fingertips_amr(
  themes = "all",
  rolling = c("include", "exclude", "only"),
  out_dir = NULL,
  refresh = FALSE,
  profile_id = .fingertips_profile_id,
  max_tries = 3L,
  retry_wait = 5,
  pause = 0.5,
  as_data_table = FALSE,
  verbose = TRUE
)
```

## Arguments

- themes:

  character vector of themes to download: any of `"prescribing"`,
  `"resistance"`, `"testing"`, `"cases"`, `"stewardship"`, `"ipc"`,
  `"other"`, or `"all"` (the default).

- rolling:

  `"include"` (default) downloads rolling and discrete series,
  `"exclude"` drops rolling series, `"only"` keeps only rolling series.

- out_dir:

  optional output directory (created if needed). See the section on
  files written. `NULL` (default) keeps everything in memory.

- refresh:

  if `TRUE`, re-download indicators even if a cached file exists in
  `out_dir`.

- profile_id:

  Fingertips profile ID; the default, 101, is "AMR local indicators -
  produced by the UKHSA".

- max_tries:

  number of attempts per indicator before it is recorded as failed.

- retry_wait:

  seconds to wait after a failed attempt, multiplied by the attempt
  number.

- pause:

  seconds to wait between indicators, to be polite to the API.

- as_data_table:

  if `TRUE`, return a `data.table` rather than a `data.frame`.

- verbose:

  show progress messages.

## Value

The combined long table (a `data.frame`, or `data.table` if
`as_data_table = TRUE`), with two attributes: `attr(x, "catalogue")`
(the selected indicators) and `attr(x, "download_log")` (status, rows
and seconds per indicator). Attributes are dropped by subsetting, so
keep a reference to the full object, or read the files from `out_dir`.
`NULL` (invisibly) is returned if no indicator matches the selection; an
empty data.frame, with a warning, if every download failed.

## Details

Every indicator is first classified by name (see
[`classify_fingertips_indicators`](https://vargasrichards.github.io/ukamrdataR/reference/classify_fingertips_indicators.md)),
and the time-period labels are parsed to dates (see
[`parse_fingertips_period`](https://vargasrichards.github.io/ukamrdataR/reference/parse_fingertips_period.md)).
The result is one long table with columns: `indicator_id`,
`indicator_name`, `area_code`, `area_name`, `area_type`, `parent_code`,
`parent_name`, `timeperiod`, `value`, `count`, `denominator`,
`ci95_lower`, `ci95_upper`, the parsed `period_start`, `period_end` and
(for 12-month rolling series) `window_start`, the classification columns
`theme`, `organism`, `specimen`, `onset`, `is_rolling`, `period_type`,
`Domains`, and `area_org_code`: the NHS organisation (ODS) code parsed
from the end of Sub-ICB / ICB names (for GPs and trusts `area_code`
already is the ODS code). Verify `area_org_code` against your own lookup
before joining on it. Any further columns returned by fingertipsR are
kept unchanged.

Downloads are slow (one API call sequence per indicator) and are
therefore **cached and resumable** when `out_dir` is given: each
indicator is stored in `<out_dir>/raw/indicator_<ID>.rds` and skipped on
the next call unless `refresh = TRUE`. If a call is interrupted or some
indicators fail, simply run it again.

## Files written when `out_dir` is supplied

- `indicator_catalogue.csv`:

  one row per indicator in the profile (all themes, regardless of
  `themes`): theme, rolling flag, period type, organism / specimen tags,
  domains and UKHSA metadata.

- `raw/indicator_<ID>.rds`:

  cached per-indicator download.

- `download_log.csv`:

  status, rows and seconds per indicator.

- `fingertips_amr_long.rds`, `fingertips_amr_long.csv.gz`:

  the combined table, as returned.

- `indicator_coverage.csv`:

  from
  [`summarise_fingertips_coverage`](https://vargasrichards.github.io/ukamrdataR/reference/summarise_fingertips_coverage.md).

With the default `out_dir = NULL` nothing is written to disk and nothing
is cached between calls.

## See also

[`fingertips_amr_indicators`](https://vargasrichards.github.io/ukamrdataR/reference/fingertips_amr_indicators.md)
to preview the selection;
[`get_data`](https://vargasrichards.github.io/ukamrdataR/reference/get_data.md)
for the (separate) UKHSA Data Dashboard API.

## Examples

``` r
# \donttest{
if (requireNamespace("fingertipsR", quietly = TRUE)) {
  # discrete (non-rolling) resistance series only, kept in memory
  res <- download_fingertips_amr(themes = "resistance", rolling = "exclude")
  head(res)

  # everything, cached and resumable on disk
  download_fingertips_amr(out_dir = file.path(tempdir(), "fingertips_amr"))
}
```
